input.question: After World War 2 how did America end up with their economy improved and the rest of the world ended up broke?
input.ground_truth: America didn't get bombed and saw *immense* federal spending that ended the great depression. Also, as it turns out, being the only industrial power that didn't get bombed to hell makes your economy pretty strong as there isn't a whole lot of competition.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: After World War 2 how did America end up with their economy improved and the rest of the world ended up broke?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you and your friends are playing a big game together. You all have a lemonade stand, but then a big storm (that’s like World War 2) comes and messes everything up. Some of your stands get destroyed, and you all run out of lemons and sugar.

But guess what? Your house (that’s like America) wasn’t hit as hard by the storm. In fact, while everyone else was busy fixing up after the storm, you (America) were actually making more lemons and sugar than before! You even helped your friends a little by giving them some lemons and sugar, but you still had lots left.

At the same time, your friends’ stands were so broken that they didn’t have enough lemons or sugar to make lemonade for a while. So, after the storm, you have lots of lemonade and money, but your friends don’t have as much.

That’s kind of what happened after World War 2. America’s factories and farms weren’t destroyed like many other countries. Instead, America made a lot of stuff and helped other countries a little, but mostly kept a lot for themselves. So, America’s economy got really strong, while many other countries were still fixing their own things and didn’t have as much money.
